problem.label: The challenge
problem.title: Great ideas deserve great digital experiences.
problem.body: Your business shouldn't be held back by an outdated website, a frustrating digital experience, or the complexity of building something new.

items.title: Your website no longer fits
items.body: Your business has moved on, and your online presence hasn't kept up.

items.title: Customers lose their way
items.body: When a digital experience is confusing, the people you want to reach move on.

guide.label: Your guide
guide.title: You bring the vision. We help you find the way.
guide.body: Building something digital can feel overwhelming, especially when it matters this much. We listen first, explain things in plain language, and take care of the design and development with you.
guide.proofTitle: See it, don't take our word for it.
guide.proofBody: Every project in our portfolio is a real, live website or application. Open them, use them, and judge the work for yourself.

about.label: About NCAI
about.title: Your vision comes first.
about.body: NCAI is a digital development business in Mozambique. We help entrepreneurs, businesses, brands and organisations turn their ideas into professional digital experiences.
about.beliefTitle: An ambitious business deserves a digital presence that reflects its potential.

principles.title: We start with your customer
principles.body: Before we design anything, we look at who you need to reach and what they need to do. The experience follows from that.

principles.title: We design it to fit you
principles.body: A clinic and a gym should not feel the same. Every project gets its own visual direction, rather than a template with a new logo.

principles.title: We build what we design
principles.body: Design and development happen together, so what you approve is what your customers actually use.

principles.title: We keep it clear
principles.body: You will always know what is happening and what comes next, in plain language, without technical overwhelm.

privacy.label: Legal
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: This website belongs to NCAI Consultorias e Serviços, EI, a business in Mozambique.

sections.title: What this website collects
sections.body: This website has no contact form, no user accounts and no analytics or advertising tools, and it does not ask you for personal information. It does not set cookies for tracking.

sections.title: Technical data
sections.body: Like most websites, it is delivered by a hosting provider, currently Vercel, whose systems may process technical information such as your IP address and browser type in order to deliver the site securely.

sections.title: When you contact us
sections.body: If you contact us on WhatsApp, by email or by phone, we receive the information you choose to share and use it only to reply and to discuss your project. Those conversations also pass through the provider of that service, under its own privacy terms.

sections.title: Links to other websites
sections.body: Our portfolio links to websites that we do not operate. Each one has its own privacy practices.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.body: You can ask us what information we hold from your messages, or ask us to correct or delete it, by writing to the email address below.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: If this policy changes, we will update this page and the date above.
